from flask import Flask, request, make_response

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/showName')
def name():
    '''
    Get "name" from the request, validate it,
    make a response with it, and return the response object
    '''
    name_param = request.args.get('name')
    
    if name_param is None or name_param.strip() == '':
        response = make_response('Invalid or missing name parameter', 400)
        return response
    
    # Validate that name contains only allowed characters (letters, spaces, hyphens, apostrophes)
    if not all(c.isalpha() or c in " -'" for c in name_param):
        response = make_response('Invalid name format', 400)
        return response
    
    response = make_response(name_param)
    return response
